name: Voxel disintegrate and re-form
description: A pixel or voxel icon shatters into cubes which re-form as the next icon.

recipe.build: InstancedMesh of 600-2000 cubes; positions tween between two sampled point sets with a seeded random delay; motion blur via shader or stretched scale.

use_when: Swapping metaphors (telling to showing); pixel or retro brand styles.
avoid: Do not use in a flat editorial or photographic style world.
